articles.title: ‘Very racist’ Netflix SBF series, BitMart’s $319M shortfall: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Netflix’s The Altruist has been slammed for its ‘very racist’ portrayal of CZ. BitMart reportedly has a $319.5 million shortfall and just $1.9M in liquid assets.

articles.title: $7 Billion in Bitcoin Options Just Expired: Here’s What It Means
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s largest options expiry this month comes as traders increasingly seek protection against further losses, with some hedging against a potential drop to $40,000 before the end of the year.

articles.title: China's Google Just Released Its Fast New AI Model for Free
articles.snippet: Baidu has released the weights of its new high-speed reasoning model, giving developers a commercially usable alternative to proprietary AI services from OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic
